svg.title: What the demo starts
svg.desc: docker compose up first runs the container secrets, which makes the password into demo/.env and a volume. Paperless-ngx with Redis and Nextcloud with PostgreSQL, the cron and a worker then start from that volume, and the app comes from the App Store or the checkout. The container init fills Paperless with the synthetic documents, creates the user demo and the account of the app, connects the app, starts a dry run and then the first run, and prints where everything is.
